name: Angkor Wat & Siem Reap
about: Cool-dry season Nov–Feb is most comfortable for temple-hopping, hot season Mar–May is intense, monsoon Jun–Oct brings dramatic skies but muddy paths.
overview: The largest religious monument on Earth, part of a vast temple complex explored by tuk-tuk over several days.
costOverview: Food, coffee, and shared tuk-tuks all cost very little — the multi-day Angkor temple pass is the one real fixed cost every visitor pays.
